title: Dormant AV1 encoder descriptors
summary: Adds dormant AV1/NVENC and libaom AV1 descriptors plus descriptor-level flag-generation assertions without routing AV1 choices through the active descriptor resolver.
reason: Continue the encoder-breadth migration toward descriptor-backed AV1 support while preserving existing encode-argument parity and keeping new AV1 paths inactive until capability probing, runtime topology checks, fallback wiring, and real-media validation are ready.
behavior_before: The descriptor catalog covered active HEVC/NVENC and libx265 parity paths plus dormant H.264 entries. AV1 choices still fell through the legacy NVENC-shaped branch, and no descriptor-level AV1 flag shape was pinned.
behavior_after: The descriptor catalog includes dormant AV1/NVENC and libaom AV1 entries. Direct descriptor calls emit AV1-specific flags, AV1/NVENC omits HEVC main10 profile flags, libaom AV1 maps p1-p7 to cpu-used values, and unsupported libaom HDR use fails closed. Resolve-MediaEncoderDescriptorForFlags still returns null for AV1 choices, so current pipeline behavior remains unchanged.
manual_validation: bundled ffmpeg -encoders - confirmed libaom-av1, libsvtav1, av1_nvenc, av1_qsv, and av1_amf are advertised
bundled ffmpeg -h encoder=av1_nvenc - confirmed -cq and p1-p7 preset support
bundled ffmpeg -h encoder=libaom-av1 - confirmed -crf, -cpu-used, -row-mt, and -aom-params support
bundled ffmpeg -h encoder=libsvtav1 - confirmed encoder is present; left as future enum fan-out
pwsh -NoProfile -File ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1 - passed (22 encode snapshots unchanged; dormant AV1 descriptor guards passed)
rollback_plan: Revert MP-CHANGE-2026-0619-042 to remove the dormant AV1 descriptors, libaom flag generation, focused assertions, generated summaries, and documentation updates. No runtime state or media files are mutated by this change.
notes:
Add dormant AV1/NVENC and libaom AV1 descriptor catalog and direct flag checks without activating resolver selection.
Real-media validation was not run; no AV1 encoder path is activated by this packet.
Refresh generated summaries for the dormant AV1 descriptor slice.
Regenerate project index/dependency graph after AV1 descriptor summary updates.
